terra.problem: “Nothing about serving God was left to chance” overstates the passage, which says the divisions were assigned by lot.
“Everybody gets a place” goes beyond the passage. It says family heads and younger brothers cast lots alike, not that every individual received a place.

The passage says the priestly divisions were recorded before the king, not that every name in the chapter was recorded there. It also does not say that every Levite family listed received a turn like the priestly divisions.
